LESSON: READING 9.2.1 READING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information, part of Strand 9 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why do we need to co-exist as a country despite our differences in culture?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to find online or offline texts on inter-ethnic cohesion,

2. conduct a silent reading session on the texts,

3. make notes on key ideas expressed in the texts,

4. prepare a list of vocabulary identified from the texts read,

5. work with peers to identify the meaning of the vocabulary identified,

6. collaborate with peers to create mind maps on the vocabulary and generate other related words,

7. answer direct and inferential questions from the comprehension texts.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to find online or offline texts on inter-ethnic cohesion,
2. conduct a silent reading session on the texts,
3. make notes on key ideas expressed in the texts,
4. prepare a list of vocabulary identified from the texts read,
5. work with peers to identify the meaning of the vocabulary identified,
6. collaborate with peers to create mind maps on the vocabulary and generate other related words,
7. answer direct and inferential questions from the comprehension texts.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: This is developed as the learner shows concerted effort to find online or offline texts on inter-ethnic cohesion.

• Learning to Learn: The learner builds on their learning experiences when creating mind maps on the vocabulary and

generates other related words.

Values:
• Unity: This is realised as the learner collaboratively works with peers to identify the meaning of the vocabulary identified.

• Peace: This is promoted as the learner displays accountability when conducting a silent reading session on the texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peace education: It is promoted as the learner interacts with texts on inter-ethnic cohesion thus promoting peaceful living.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of presentation of songs with correct intonation to their learning of performance in

Creative Arts and Sports.
